steps.text: Market value break on DIS in QNT-009: USD 38,868.88. If quantities agree, the gap is price or FX. I'll split it into a price effect and an FX effect and see which one carries it.
Same quantity (38,900). Price effect USD 38,868.88, FX effect USD 0.00, sum USD 38,868.88.
IBOR golden copy vs vendor closes
IBOR 2026-11-20 close 110.9166 is the vendor's prior close (2026-11-19), loaded at 2026-11-20 07:05:00.000000 before the real close was published.
Conclusion: stale price, 97% confidence. Owner: Pricing & Valuations.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  b.break_id,
  b.as_of,
  b.account_id,
  b.security_id,
  s.ticker,
  s.isin,
  s.currency AS sec_ccy,
  s.country,
  b.currency,
  b.break_type,
  b.ibor_value,
  b.custodian_value,
  b.difference,
  b.difference_usd,
  b.status
FROM breaks AS b
LEFT JOIN securities AS s
  ON s.security_id = b.security_id
WHERE
  b.break_id = 'BRK-0181'
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    'IBOR' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    price_date,
    fx_rate,
    fx_source,
    fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM ibor_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009' AND security_id = 1023
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'CUSTODIAN' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    as_of AS price_date,
    fx_rate,
    'WMR_4PM' AS fx_source,
    as_of AS fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM custodian_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009' AND security_id = 1023
) AS u
LIMIT 200

queries.sql:
SELECT
  price_date,
  source,
  close_price,
  loaded_at
FROM prices
WHERE
  security_id = 1023 AND price_date >= '2026-11-14'
ORDER BY
  price_date DESC,
  source
LIMIT 200
